name: lru-cache
description: A two-entry LRU cache: eviction order, recency refresh on read and overwrite, hit/miss results.

actions.init: construct a fresh cache with capacity 2
actions.fetch: cache.get(key), observed as Hit(value) or Miss

limits: Three keys, values 0-2, capacity 2, at most 8 steps per sampled history.
Single-threaded; the driver's projection of cache.items() is trusted.
